messages:
elaine (CS): Hey team, incoming from ACME Corp — dedicated cluster in us-west-2 not scaling up fast enough during their 9am spike. Customers saw 429s for ~7m. Ticket C-4592. Model: gpt-open-13b, min_replicas=2, max_replicas=50.
alerts-bot: automated alert: 2026-03-17T09:02:12Z - scale_delay_detected - probe_fail_rate=24% - avg_scale_latency=180s - queue_length=32
devin (support): Thanks. Can you paste the customer timeline and any proxy logs? Do we have the probe/gateway errors?
elaine (CS): Timeline: 09:00 — traffic jump x6; 09:01 — first 429s; 09:04 — autoscaler requested +8 replicas; 09:07 — only +2 replicas came up; 09:09 — fallback to smaller model started for some requests; 09:12 — steady. Attaching snippet from their gateway (redacted):
```
[09:01:05] request_id=abc123 status=429 route=/v1/generate latency_ms=12
[09:01:32] scaler.request desired=10 -> provision_started
[09:03:10] pod/ri-ded-004 imagepullbackoff backoff=120s reason=ImagePullBackOff
[09:04:05] pod/ri-ded-007 AttachTimeout probe=warmup elapsed=90s
[09:07:12] scaler.actual_replicas=4
```

maria (eng-platform): Interesting — image pulls and AttachTimeouts. Could be registry throttling or warm-pool exhaustion. Do we have cluster-side events (kube events, attach logs)? Also which container registry?
samir (oncall): I can grab the autoscaler debug logs and the attach traces. For immediate mitigation: we can temporarily bump min_replicas to 6 for that tenant OR switch their routing to reserved-burst for 15m. Which do they prefer?
elaine (CS): Customer prefers min_replicas bump if it avoids fallback. They already got a degraded UX. Please action.
devin (support): Repro steps request for eng: simple curl from an external load generator that mimics their 9am pattern: 120 qps in 30s burst. Sample payload: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"gpt-open-13b","prompt":"hello"}'`
maria (eng-platform): Got it. Samir, I'll need: autoscaler logs for 08:58-09:12, kube events for the dedicated nodes, and the attach service logs (attach-service.log). Devin, ask the CS team to confirm the image registry (ecr/redwood-registry?) and whether they saw any imagepull errors in their infra.
samir (oncall): Pulling logs now. Quick grep shows repeated `AttachTimeout` and `preflight probe=429` from attach-service around 09:02-09:05. Also seeing `imagePullBackOff` with error `unauthorized: quota exceeded` for a couple of nodes.
maria (eng-platform): That points to registry rate limit causing nodes to hang during startup -> warm pool depleted -> autoscaler can't reach desired capacity. Two parallel issues: registry throttling and probe pacing. We'll: 1) identify which nodes hit image pull quota, 2) add short-term mitigation (bump min_replicas -> 6 for tenant), 3) recommend customer enable cached images or private mirror.
devin (support): Noted. Also let's confirm whether warm-pool prewarmed containers were being evicted right before the spike (oom/kube reclaims?). Any eviction events?
samir (oncall): Checking... I see `kubelet evict: pods with label warmpool=true` around 08:55 on several nodes — likely due to a cluster-wide reclaim after a maintenance job. That explains why warm pool was 0 at spike.
elaine (CS): Ugh — customer says they didn't run anything. They rely on our reserved warm pool. They want root cause + fix ASAP.
maria (eng-platform): Action plan: (A) immediate: Samir to bump min_replicas to 6 and enable reserved_burst routing for ACME (09:20 ETA). (B) short-term: investigate registry throttling and request rate increase from registry team or enable local image cache. (C) long-term: change warm-pool eviction policy for dedicated clusters (protect warmpool label from reclaim during maintenance). I'll open infra ticket INF-2026.
samir (oncall): Doing the min_replicas bump now. Command: `ri admin update-tenant --org acme --min-replicas 6 --reason "temp mitig for spike 2026-03-17"` -> applied. Monitoring.
alerts-bot: config_change: tenant acme min_replicas set to 6 by samir at 2026-03-17T09:22:04Z
devin (support): I'll reply to the customer: we applied a temporary min_replicas increase and will follow up with permanent recommendations. Can you capture the final timeline and next steps?
elaine (CS): Thanks all. Please paste follow-ups here. I already notified C-4592 with the mitigation. Also flagging this for on-call postmortem if we see repeats. :+1:
maria (eng-platform): Follow-ups: need autoscaler debug + attach-service traces uploaded to the incident bucket, and the registry request logs to confirm quota hits. I'll own the INF-2026 ticket for eviction policy.
samir (oncall): Logs uploaded: s3://incidents/3120001111/autoscaler.log and attach traces. Will keep monitoring for 30m.
devin (support): Copy. I'll add the customer's observed 429 sample and the curl repro snippet to the ticket.
elaine (CS): Closing loop with customer now. If anything else pops up I’ll ping. Thanks everyone.
